confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live menus, booking pages or current listings. Food and drink anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain because rates vary by area and July is generally low season. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5 times beer; wine glass slightly above beer) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. USD values approximate rand price levels at a rough recent exchange rate. The FX value came from a search summary of the RBA page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Cape Town's own visitor-facing price levels from general knowledge, with restaurant prices reflecting central and tourist-district dining and accommodation reflecting off-peak July demand.
